facts.text: I am trying to get better at meal planning.
I am trying to reduce food waste.
I recently had a big breakfast at a café that included scrambled eggs, sausages, and hash browns.
I consider that café breakfast a treat and not something I can have every day.
I like the scrambled egg muffins.
I want healthy snacks that I can prep on the weekends.
I want snacks that are more substantial than carrot sticks with hummus or air-popped popcorn.
I want snacks that will help me cut down on coffee and cookies at work.
I like the energy balls and trail mix ideas.
I want healthy lunch ideas that I can prep on the weekends.
I want lunch ideas that use leftovers from dinner but are more exciting.
I want lunch ideas that will help me stop relying on the deli near the office.
I want healthy dinner ideas that I can cook at home.
I want dinner ideas that can help me use up ingredients I already have in my pantry.
I made chicken parmesan with pasta last week.
I like the one-pot pasta with vegetables idea.
I want healthy dessert ideas that are easy to make.
I want dessert ideas that will not sabotage my diet.
I want dessert ideas that will help me cut down on cookies and coffee at work.
